name: ec-merger-phase2-opening

persistence.definition: inapplicable: each row is a newly notified case with no prior observation of the same entity at the instant; the nearest analogue is recent_rate

recent_rate.definition: constant train positive rate over the last three train years [2011, 2012, 2013] (0.02659); regime-drift probe

sector_division_rate.definition: REQUIRED COMPARATOR: train-fitted positive rate per NACE division (corrected grouping), averaged over the case's divisions, global train rate fallback

sector_combo_rate.definition: train rate per exact sector_divisions string, global fallback

calendar_identity.definition: train rate per (regulation, notification month): era identity plus seasonal prior, training rows only

title_text.definition: train rate per party-name token (>=3 alphanumeric chars, >= 5 train rows), averaged, global fallback

majority_class.definition: majority = int(train_positive_rate >= 0.5), measured against THIS split's labels

global_rate.definition: constant train positive rate; no ranking information

full_model: NOT computed at this stage: the harness runner's baseline job trains and evaluates the full model on these same eval rows; quote its figure beside these references when it exists

prevalence_shift.note: train 1990-2013 vs eval 2014-2018 vs holdout 2019-snapshot base rates, read from meta.json (gate-verified); a shift is an out-of-distribution property to report, not a construction fault

sector_vs_global.note: paired row bootstrap on identical eval rows; an interval containing zero is an inconclusive difference, not parity

sector_vs_calendar_identity.note: paired row bootstrap on identical eval rows; an interval containing zero is an inconclusive difference, not parity

title_text_vs_sector.note: paired row bootstrap on identical eval rows; an interval containing zero is an inconclusive difference, not parity
